summary.scope: 18-case retrospective exploratory screen. Pending rows are not failures. E003 uses 20s without revision; pilot uses 40s plus up to four LLM calls. Canonical uses the correct model; it is not an end-to-end baseline. One instance per stratum and one seed cannot establish stable superiority; no degenerate singleton bootstrap CI. Costs cover completed records, not total GPU-hours or energy.

config.pilot_scope: exploratory retrospective stratified pilot; no formal quality acceptance claim

selection.rule: min sha256(seed NUL case_id) per dataset; no outcome/validity filtering

manifest.scope: Exploratory pilot; no formal acceptance bypass or algorithm superiority claim

metric_reference_and_summary_checks: 72 score metrics and all method aggregate counts match; reference gold hashes verified
